frames.caption_pilot: the 100 pilot pages of audits/aamas_pages, drawn by study/sample_pages.py: papers in a seeded random order, one page drawn uniformly among each paper's pages (of the first 40) holding a 'Table N:' caption line; one page per paper, so page = paper cluster
frames.noncaption: the 100 pages of audits/aamas_noncaption: random pages after the first and before the references on which the parser detected no caption (pool 5612 pages, 827 papers; draw.json)

draw.caption_pilot: 30 of 100, simple random sample without replacement (random.Random(seed).sample on the sorted ids); the 35 hard-case pages were NOT used to select or exclude anything, and a drawn page that is also a hard-case page is kept and flagged
draw.noncaption: 20 of 100, same rule; a separate stratum, scored separately
draw.overlap: 8 of the 30 caption pages for a second annotator

estimands.unweighted: a random caption page of a random paper (the pilot's own design)
estimands.weighted: all caption pages: each page weighted by its paper's number of caption pages (the inverse of its within-paper selection probability)

ids: P01-P30 caption pages (set 'core'), P31-P50 non-caption pages (set 'extra'); ids carry no machine reading
